overall_reason: Pressing 'Add note' rolls only the changed word to 'Hide', opens the note with a 400 ms grid-template-rows transition that carries the shipping line down with it, and collapses it faster than it opened.

score.reason: T-CONTINUITY and T-ENTER-EXIT pass, and T-MOTION-SYSTEM passes on one ease-out family; the open and close are caught only at their ends.

strengths: Only 'Add' rolls to 'Hide' while 'note' stays in place, so the button changes only what changed (MOT-254).
The note opens over 400 ms (grid-template-rows, not height, MOT-116) and closes in 320 ms after an 80 ms delay, so the exit is quicker than the entrance (MOT-009).
The 'Standard shipping' line moves down by the note's 52 px within the same transition, with no shove (motion_snap 0 hits).
not_investigated: The reduced-motion recording shows movement until 236 ms; the reduced-motion check (A11-011) belongs to the sweep, which reports 0 hits.
Frame-level timing: the passive stills are seven shots over 6 s from a separate load, so durations and curves come from the declarations at 1440, not from frames between stills.
Sweep motion (MOT-002) is not-verified: motion capture was skipped (--no-motion) and there were no click runs; async_state (CMP-001) is not-verified (--no-async).
T-RAPID-TOGGLE and interruptibility: no detector built and no click runs.
Gestures and drags as a person plays them, scroll-driven motion, hover as it plays (only declarations read), and route or page transitions: not captured.
The shared stylesheet's 8 motion_css (MOT-001) hits belong to the sweep and are not repeated here.
